snapshot.what_it_does: Titan Company Limited is a lifestyle company (part of the Tata Group ecosystem per the MD's remarks) that designs, manufactures and retails watches, jewellery and eyewear through large retail networks, and also operates a B2B engineering and automation subsidiary (TEAL). In FY2025-26 it crossed ₹75,000+ crore consolidated revenue (excluding bullion), delivering 28% revenue growth.

segments.name: Jewellery
segments.note: Largest revenue line: manufactured jewellery ₹52,405 crore + traded ₹8,529 crore (p328); grew 33% with 27% same-store growth; brands include Tanishq (528 stores), Mia (₹2,000+ crore, 292 stores), CaratLane (378 stores, >30% growth), Zoya (13 boutiques); launched LGD brand 'beYon'; acquired 67% of Damas Jewellery (p153-156)

segments.name: Watches
segments.note: 17% NSV growth; analog watches grew 24% vs market 18%, ~27% analog market share; 1,292 retail stores (743 Titan World, 288 Helios, 252 Fastrack, 9 Helios Luxe) (p154)

segments.name: EyeCare
segments.note: Returned to double-digit growth in H2 FY2025-26; 'Vision meets Fashion' strategy (p153)

segments.name: Emerging businesses
segments.note: Fragrances & Women's Bags performed well; Indian Dress Wear muted (p153)

segments.name: TEAL (B2B Engineering)
segments.note: Wholly owned subsidiary; one of its best performances, driven by automation solutions for electronics manufacturing (p153)

snapshot.geographies: Primarily India; international jewellery business expanding in North America (CaratLane stores in New Jersey and Dallas) with GCC presence impacted by geopolitical developments in March (p153, p156).
key_facts: Total income (standalone) ₹78,089 crore; Profit After Tax ₹4,630 crore; EBIT ₹7,242 crore at 9.3% margin (p14)
Consolidated revenue crossed ₹76,000+ crore (excluding bullion), 28% growth (p153)
3,603 stores across 46 lakh sq. ft. retail area; 11 manufacturing and assembly facilities (p14)
Jewellery Division grew 33% with 27% same-store growth; Watches grew 17% (p154-155)
CSR spend ₹90 crore reaching 9.8 lakh+ beneficiaries across 66 social intervention areas (p13)

promised_vs_delivered.verdict: Management's growth and strategic promises (Q3 acceleration, Damas consolidation, Q1 FY27 ticket-size benefit) were largely delivered with figures to show. Margin commitments were only partly kept—CaratLane stayed just below double digits and jewellery hovered near 11%—and store-count targets could not be verified from later calls.

rows.promise: Jewellery YTD-December growth to beat H1 FY26 growth rates
rows.delivered: Q3 FY26 revenue +43.3% YoY (actuals); jewellery grew ~40% in Q3 (Q3 call), well above H1's 24.6-28.8%

rows.promise: Q1's 50bps jewellery margin one-off to reverse over next two quarters
rows.delivered: Q2 saw no net impact (Q2 call); Q3 margin fell ~50bps YoY with no one-offs (Q3 call)
rows.cite: Q2 FY26 reported; Q3 FY26 reported

rows.promise: 40 Tanishq store additions in FY26 (35-40 reasonable range)
rows.delivered: Only 9 by September plus 8 in October reported; full-year FY26 store count not stated in later calls

rows.promise: Keep jewellery margin range-bound with 11% floor despite gold headwinds
rows.delivered: Q3 margin -50bps YoY (Q3 call); normalized 10.9% in Q1 FY27 (Q1 call)—near, not clearly above, 11%
rows.cite: Q3 FY26 reported; Q1 FY27 reported

rows.promise: Damas consolidated from 1 January; Q4 FY26 results to include Damas
rows.delivered: Q4 revenue +80.5% YoY (actuals); Q4 call reported international/Damas Q4 loss of ₹82 crores and integration updates

rows.promise: CaratLane to sustain a low double-digit EBIT margin
rows.delivered: Q4 8.4%, FY26 nearly 10% (Q4 call); 9.6% in Q1 FY27 (Q1 call)—hovering just below double digits
rows.cite: Q4 & FY26 reported; Q1 FY27 reported

rows.promise: Eyecare to keep delivering volume growth of around 8-10%
rows.delivered: Q3 volume growth ~8% (Q3 call), within band; Q4 and Q1 FY27 calls do not state eyecare volumes

rows.promise: Gold-price ticket-size benefit expected in Q1-Q2 FY27
rows.delivered: Q1 FY27 LFL growth >30%, record May-June (Q1 call); revenue +29.3% YoY (actuals)

rows.promise: beYon to reach 10-12 stores; several in place by Q1 FY27
rows.delivered: Q1 FY27 call's reported items do not mention beYon store count; progress not stated

rows.promise: ₹407 crore customs duty gains to flow through P&L over Q2-Q3 FY27
rows.delivered: ₹407cr realized in Q1 (Q1 call); Q2-Q3 FY27 not yet reported, flow-through pending

bull.point: Consolidated revenue crossed ₹76,000 crore ex-bullion, +28%; Q1 FY27 revenue +29.3% YoY and PAT +62.9%, showing momentum.
Jewellery grew 33% with 27% same-store growth; Q3 revenue +43.3% and Q4 +80.5% with Damas consolidated.
Q1 FY27 margins improved to 13.5% EBITDA and 12.3% operating; ₹407 crore customs-duty flow-through is pending for Q2-Q3.

bear.point: Q4 FY26 margin compressed to 7.2% EBITDA and 6.3% operating despite +80.5% revenue, showing mix can dilute profitability.
Jewellery margin promise was only partly kept: Q3 fell ~50bps YoY and Q1 FY27 normalized 10.9%, near not clearly above 11%.
CaratLane stayed below low double-digit EBIT margin (8.4% Q4, 9.6% Q1 FY27); international/Damas posted ₹82 crore Q4 loss.

watch: Q2-Q3 FY27 flow-through of ₹407 crore customs-duty gains and whether jewellery margin holds above 11%.
Damas integration losses and GCC geopolitical impact on international jewellery.
Whether Q1 FY27 >30% LFL/ticket-size benefit sustains; Tanishq additions and beYon store count are not stated.
